comments.author: @Gonzinator805
comments.text: I told my buddy about this movie  (both of us originally from Santa Barbara CA) and watched it together then a couple of years later we decided to head up to Buellton California and actually stayed at the windmill inn before they renamed it sideways inn. That night we walked to Hitching Post and ended up meeting up with two girls from Solvang CA on tinder and ended up having an amazing time. It’s been 6 years since we took that trip but I think it’s time to go there again but this time actually start from LA to Buellton and stop at some of the movie locations and hopefully ending our trip with burgers and wine 🍷 🍔
